as_told.title: Grusch suggests Dick Cheney was a UFO program gatekeeper

plain: The former vice president Dick Cheney is said to have sat at the top of the pyramid of UFO secrecy, as gatekeeper of the long-running secret UFO programmes. The chain is second hand: the journalist Walter Kirn says the whistleblower David Grusch told him so, after Michels introduced the two. Michels tells it several times, once recalling asking who "sits atop the pyramid of classified information" and being told "Dick Cheney", and once hedging that Grusch suggested "someone like" Cheney. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb adds that Cheney held the role "for quite a while", up to about 2009. If true, it would put the secret in the hands of one of the most powerful men in government.
